events.name: Western Michigan Broncos at Akron Zips

headlines.description: — Jalen Buckley dashed for 121 yards and two touchdowns, Cole Cabana added 107 rushing yards and a score, and Western Michigan defeated Akron 42-14 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buckley, Cabana power rushing attack for Western Michigan in 42-14 win over Akron

events.name: Kent State Golden Flashes at Bowling Green Falcons

headlines.description: — Austin Novosad threw for 229 yards and three touchdowns in his first career start, and Nakai Amachree scored twice as Bowling Green rallied past Kent State 33-28 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Novosad and Amachree help Bowling Green edge Kent State 33-28

headlines.description: — Miami (Ohio) scored 34 unanswered points behind true freshman quarterback Drew Bellisari in his first collegiate game, and the RedHawks spotted Ohio 17 points before ending the Bobcats' six-game win streak with a 34-17 victory on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: True freshman QB Drew Bellisari rallies Miami (Ohio) to 34-17 victory over Ohio in debut
